  MEETING OF THE
  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  MONDAY, MARCH 17, 2025 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Public
Safety Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 3rd Monday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
City at (626) 300-0735 or at Fire@CityofSanMarinoCA.gov at least 48 hours prior to the
meeting.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:
  Public comment will be accepted by email to Fire@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00 p.m.
  the day of the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will be
  distributed to the Public Safety Commission during the meeting. Any comments
  received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not
  provided to Public Safety Commission at the meeting.

AGENDA – MARCH 17, 2025  PAGE 4 of 4
   Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference
  module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted after the in-
  person comments.
CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Commissioner Brian Davis, Commissioner Elizabeth  Feffer,  Commissioner  Charles
Martinson, Vice Chair Eliot Hodges, Chair Jeff Boozell

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Public Safety
Commission by completing a public comment card prior to the meeting. At this time, the
public may address the Public Safety Commission on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the Public Safety Commission may not discuss or take action on
issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves
the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such
items.

COMMISSIONER REPORTS

This is an opportunity for members of the Public Safety Commission to inform the public of
any meetings or conferences they may have attended.

  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  TRAFFIC CONDITIONS REVIEW AND REPORT – INTERSECTION OF
  SAN MARINO AVENUE AND HUNTINGTON DRIVE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Public Safety Commission receive and file
  the attached Traffic Review for Huntington Drive and San Marino Avenue, and
  recommend staff begin the implementation of Transtech’s recommended

AGENDA – MARCH 17, 2025  PAGE 4 of 4
   improvements. If the Commission concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  ”I move to receive and file the attached Traffic Review prepared by Transtech for
  Huntington Drive and San Marino Avenue, and recommend staff begin the
  implementation of the proposed improvements.”

 2.  FY 2024-25 CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PLAN STATUS UPDATE AND FY
  2025-26 CAPITAL EQUIPMENT REQUESTS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Public Safety Commission receive and file
  the FY 2024-25 CIP status update report and forward the proposed FY 2025-26
  capital equipment procurements to the City Council. If the Commission concurs with
  staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the FY 2024-25 capital improvement status update report
  and forward the proposed FY 2025-26 capital equipment list to the City Council for
  approval.”

 3.  PARKS AND PUBLIC WORKS MONTHLY REPORT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Public Safety Commission receive and file
  this report. If the Commission concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  ”I move to receive and file the February 2025 Parks and Public Works Department
  Report.”

 4.  FIRE DEPARTMENT MONTHLY REPORT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission receive and file the Fire
  Department Monthly Report. If the Commission concurs with staff’s recommendation,
  an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Fire Department Monthly Report.”

 5.  POLICE DEPARTMENT MONTHLY REPORT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission receive and file the Police
  Department Monthly Report. If the Commission concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Police Department Monthly Report.”

 6.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission approve the minutes of special
  meeting of February 24, 2025. If the Commission concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

AGENDA – MARCH 17, 2025  PAGE 4 of 4
   ”I move to approve the minutes of the special meeting of February 24, 2025”.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at least a majority of the Public
Safety Commission regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at the Public
Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.
